title: Explainable light-weight deep learning pipeline for improved drought stress identification
summary: The lightweight model identifies drought stress from sensor imagery as a specific crop-monitoring task. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
organization: North Eastern Regional Institute of Science and Technology (NERIST); Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Guwahati

evidence.tested: The lightweight model identifies drought stress from sensor imagery as a specific crop-monitoring task.
evidence.unknown: No prospective clinical benefit or broader external validity is established by the documented study.
evidence.ai_role: The lightweight model identifies drought stress from sensor imagery as a specific crop-monitoring task.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
